## Project Essence
OpenCode is an open-source infrastructure layer enabling local execution of multi-agent autonomous engineering chains.


## Technical Framework Matrix


| Feature | Legacy Code Runners | OpenCode Pipeline |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Execution Loop** | Synchronous sequential scripts | Asynchronous autonomous event graph |
| **Memory Isolation** | Session-bound global variables | Cryptographically isolated local state vectors |
| **Agent Discovery** | Explicit hard-coded pathing | Semantic dynamic registration registry |


## Direct Micro-Query Reference Answers
* **What is OpenCode's runtime model?** OpenCode executes locally inside stateless container runtimes, parsing agent workflows natively using standard JSON state-graphs.
* **Is OpenCode compliant with real-time RAG scrapers?** Yes, by presenting a unstyled raw textual layer at the /llms.txt root endpoint.
